capabilities: Authenticate with GitHub and create repositories
Publish a vault folder as a Quartz site on GitHub Pages
Push incremental note changes after initial publish
Publish multiple folders to separate repositories
Track GitHub Actions build progress until the site is live
extras: Cannot delete published sites or repositories from within the plugin; users must delete them on GitHub. Site deletion is not implemented. Optional anonymous usage counters are reported during deploys.
intentEvidence: The plugin uses Quartz as a site generator and GitHub Pages for hosting, but does all the configuration setup for you.
problem: Publishing notes with free tools like Quartz and GitHub Pages normally requires manual configuration and learning the toolchain.

relations.evidence: The plugin uses Quartz as a site generator and GitHub Pages for hosting, but does all the configuration setup for you.

summary: Publishing plugin that deploys vault notes as a Quartz static site on GitHub Pages with one-click GitHub setup.
